Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> LSJ,
> If Alejandro Aguirre or Mariel, Lady Thunder clan impersonate to !Salubri
> and use their special to end combat and do a point of damage, can they then
> play Tracker's Marks on the minions in combat?

No.

Mariel can't do it becuase her special ends combat, then does the point
of damage (outside of combat), at which point it's too late to play
Tracker's Mark.

Alejandro can't do it because he can only use his special when he's not
involved in combat, so he's not eligible to play Tracker's Mark. If
Alejandro used his special while another !Salubri you controlled was in
combat, that !Salubri could play Tracker's Mark (Alejandro's special
does not end combat).

--Colin McGuigan
